candidate.raw_translation: Norway kawai. Wannan wani taimakon shirye-shirye ne, ba wani hukuncin da ya dace ba, ƙididdiga na biyan riba, ƙayyade haƙƙoƙin ma'aikaci ko aikace-aikacen NAV. Taswirar ƙa'ida tana tsammanin iyaye biyu sun samu haƙƙi. Ayyukan ƙa'idodi, matsalolin iyaye guda, haihuwar da ta gabata, cuta, canje-canje na lokaci guda, haɗin kan iyakoki da ƙididdiga na riba na mutum na iya canza sakamakon; bincika NAV don waɗannan matsalolin.
candidate.source: Norway only. This is a planning aid, not an eligibility decision, benefit-payment calculation, employer leave-rights determination or NAV application. The standard table assumes both parents have earned a right. Activity rules, one-parent cases, early birth, illness, simultaneous leave exceptions, cross-border coordination and individualized income calculations can change the result; check NAV for those cases.
